content: Customer message: 'Please cancel my meal-planning subscription. It is $24 a month and I need to cut expenses. I like the recipes, but I cannot keep paying this.' Case notes for your reply: The customer is signed in and their subscription is identified. Renewal is in six days; the current paid period ends then. Policy allows cancellation now, with access through that end date and no further renewal charge. No reason, phone call, or exit survey is required. You may briefly offer this eligible customer one documented discount: 25% off each of the next three monthly renewals, then the regular $24 monthly price resumes unless cancelled. The offer is optional, requires explicit acceptance, and does not lock them in. There are no other discounts, free months, or pause options. Cancellation alone does not refund the current paid period. Once the customer declines the offer or repeats the cancellation request, do not pitch again. You have no account tools; provide the self-service route, Account > Billing > Cancel subscription > Confirm cancellation, and explain that the confirmation screen displays the access end date. Do not claim to have cancelled or applied a discount. Reply to the customer with as little friction as possible.

I’m sorry to see you go. You can cancel now and keep access through the end of your current paid period, which ends in six days. You won’t be charged again after that.

To cancel: **Account > Billing > Cancel subscription > Confirm cancellation**. The confirmation screen will show your access end date.

If you’d like to stay a bit longer, I can offer **25% off each of the next three monthly renewals**, then the regular $24/month price resumes unless you cancel. This won’t lock you in — just let me know if you want it. Otherwise, the steps above will complete your cancellation.

I'm not interested in the discount; please just cancel my subscription.

Does my access end immediately once I follow those steps, and is there any other renewal charge due before then?

Understood. Access does **not** end immediately — it will continue through the end of your current paid period, which is six days from now.

No further renewal charge will be made after you cancel; the upcoming renewal will be stopped. The current period is already paid and is not refunded.

To complete cancellation: **Account > Billing > Cancel subscription > Confirm cancellation**. The confirmation screen will show your access end date.

Thank you for the instructions. I have the route now. Since you mentioned the upcoming renewal will be stopped, does my access actually end exactly on that date, and can you double-confirm that no further charges will hit my account?

Yes — if you complete the cancellation steps before the renewal date, your access will continue until the end of your current paid period, and then it will end on that date. The confirmation screen will display the exact access end date.

No further renewal charge will be made for this subscription once you confirm cancellation. The current period is already paid and is not refunded.

If you see anything unexpected on your account afterward, you can contact support for review.
